name: com.mycore.debugmenukit
description: In-game two-level debug/cheat menu for Unity, driven by [DebugMethod] attributes. Drop the prefab in your boot scene, add your own MonoBehaviour with attributed methods (or AddButton at runtime) and every cheat shows up automatically. FPS counter, version display, clear-user-data, 4-finger-tap / F1 toggle. Zero third-party dependencies.
